note: Tending by any means (SIM_VERSION 15): the room bloom (bonus + supply pod) and the floor restore follow the corruption, not the CLEANSE action. Reclaimer Bomb converts the floor's only oil at (4,1) to growth; the room it sat in now holds no corruption, so it blooms, and the floor holds none, so it is restored - the payoffs a cleanse of the same tile pays. Before bump 15 both lived inside _act_cleanse alone and a convert or a wash that took the last of it paid neither (the owner's report). Game.step snapshots the corrupt rooms before every player action except end_turn and _settle_tending pays whatever the action emptied; drop that call and this record fails in plain mode on pattern 3
